name: mscse-advisor-end-of-first-semester
description: §2.3 (September 2026 edition, DGS 2026-10-02): an M.S. student identifies an advisor by the END of the first semester, unless the ADGS grants an exception. Entered Fall 2026, no advisor: in November the row is in progress and due this semester; the July 2026 text ("by the beginning") would have had it overdue since August.

detailIncludes: by the end of your first semester (§2.3)
